tools.name: list_stocks
tools.description: Tokenized stocks listed on The River, with ticker, token symbol, issuer, chain and trade link. Filter by chain and/or a search query (ticker, symbol or name).

tools.name: trade_link
tools.description: A pre-filled River trade link. A buy by ticker with usd (no address or chain) returns a best-price link that opens the cheapest issuer for the user.
